reading_uid.description: Client-generated identifier used to de-duplicate retried deliveries

equipment_id.description: Optional cross-check: must equal the equipment the authenticated device is paired with

device_id.description: Optional cross-check: must equal the authenticated device

min_temperature.description: Calibrated minimum temperature in the window, in Celsius; within 5 of raw_min_temperature

max_temperature.description: Calibrated maximum temperature in the window, in Celsius; within 5 of raw_max_temperature

avg_temperature.description: Calibrated average temperature in the window, in Celsius; within 5 of raw_avg_temperature

raw_min_temperature.description: Minimum temperature measured by the probe before calibration, in Celsius (0 to 50)

raw_max_temperature.description: Maximum temperature measured by the probe before calibration, in Celsius (0 to 50)

raw_avg_temperature.description: Average temperature measured by the probe before calibration, in Celsius (0 to 50)

humidity.description: Average relative humidity observed in the window, as a percentage (20 to 90)

sample_count.description: Number of raw samples folded into this reading (1 to 360)

light_level_max.description: Highest light level inside the unit during the window, 0 to 100 %; omitted when the device has no light sensor

door_open_seconds.description: Seconds the door was detected open during the window; omitted when not reported

presence_detected.description: Whether the PIR sensor detected presence near the unit during the window; omitted when presence is unavailable, which is stored as unavailable, not as false

recorded_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) Timestamp assigned by the device clock

applied_config_version.description: Edge configuration version the gateway was running when it built this batch
